title: Companion HP never recovers by any means I found: resting by the fire, eating at a cook-fire, eating dried herbs, and using a purchased 'tin of miner's salve' all healed only the player character, never party members. Vell sat at 6/9 hp from roughly turn 120 through the end of the game (turn 580+) with no way to restore it.
where: Multiple / 'rest by the fire', 'eat by the cook-fire', 'use dried herbs', 'use a tin of miner's salve'
